verdict.rationale: LocalAI can load a quantized GGUF model directly from Hugging Face (phi-2.Q8_0.gguf) and supports ggml/gguf models, so it handles at least one family of quantized weights. Nothing in the evidence shows support for the formats the story names. missing for 10: explicit FP8 support, INT4 support, GPTQ support, AWQ support, documentation of which backends handle which quantization formats, independent or hands-on corroboration.
